Yesterday I took my puppies to their second grooming appointment ever. I arrived on time with their vaccine records, but the groomers spent several minutes looking over the paperwork and said they couldn't accept the vaccine cards because they "didn't look official." One of the staff members then asked if the vaccines were from Mexico.

I found that question very offensive. Instead of making an assumption, they could have simply asked where my puppies had been vaccinated. As a Hispanic customer, it felt like they immediately assumed the vaccines came from Mexico.

Another groomer told me there were "lots of other places" that would accept my vaccine cards. I explained that my puppies were vaccinated through the Arizona Humane Society. I was then asked to provide additional proof, so I had to search through my emails while the clock was ticking. By then, I was already seven minutes past my appointment time. When I asked how much time I had left, I was told there was only a 15-minute grace period.

The whole situation was incredibly stressful. I took the day off to bring my puppies here. I also asked whether I would lose my $70 deposit if I couldn't find the records quickly, but no one could give me a clear answer and said they would have to ask someone else.

I went back to my car with my puppies and was eventually able to find an invoice for one set of vaccines and another record through the Arizona Humane Society's online portal. Thankfully, after waiting two weeks for this appointment, they were still able to groom my puppies. I will add my puppies were nicely groomed.

My issue isn't that they wanted to verify the vaccine records—I'm happy to provide proof if needed. My concern is with how I was treated. I would have appreciated friendly, respectful customer service instead of assumptions about where my puppies were vaccinated and comments suggesting I should find another place that would accept my records after I made so much effort for this appointment. I didn't feel welcomed, and the overall experience left me with very uncomfortable vibes.

Unfortunately, I won't be returning.

To say my recent experiences have been disappointing would be an understatement.

I’ve been coming to this location since 2019, and over the years I’ve ordered three to four custom birthday cakes annually. Until this year, every experience had been excellent, which is why this has been so disappointing.

Every year, I’ve followed the same process: submit the custom cake request through the online form, wait for a callback, and finalize the order. This year, however, things have been completely different. On multiple occasions, I submitted my order request more than a week in advance and never received a call. When I called to ask about the status, I was told they never received my request.

The first time this happened, I understood that technical issues can occur. Since I was already on the phone, I asked if I could simply place the order then and there. I was told the baker would be out on my requested pickup date. That seemed reasonable.

The second time, the exact same thing happened. Again, my online request was supposedly never received, and again I was told the baker would be out. By the third time, it no longer felt like a coincidence.

To make sure it wasn’t just an issue on my end, I had a friend submit an order request for a pickup date seven days out. Just like my experience, she never received a callback. A few days later, she called the store to place the order over the phone. She was told the baker would be out on that pickup date. She then asked about a pickup date two weeks later and, once again, was told the baker would be out.

At this point, I’m not sure what’s going on, but something clearly isn’t working the way it used to. It’s incredibly frustrating because I’ve been a loyal customer for years and have always had positive experiences. I never expected to have this much difficulty placing a simple custom cake order, especially when giving more than enough notice.

I’m genuinely disappointed. I hope this location looks into what’s happening with the ordering process because I’d love to continue supporting a business that has done such a great job for me in the past.

We liked the shop itself, they had plenty of great toys and treats. The service they did on our pup was good and she came out looking clean and well groomed. However, this was our dog’s first grooming appointment ever and everything leading up the grooming made us not want to return for grooming services again.

For context, our dog is a former foster and had to spend a lot of time in kennels each week around other barking dogs to get her cast checked on. After adopting, we have spent a lot of time getting her comfortable with stimulation and have been working diligently to train the reactivity away.

Important to note that we made sure not to take her to get groomed until we were 100% sure she was okay being washed, brushed, and have her nails trimmed. In addition we made sure she was better around other dogs and wouldn’t go fully reactive while in proximity to them. We expected the room to be large and dogs will have a decent amount of space between the grooming stations but there was only one station in a small room.

We were hoping to drop her off at 12 (when we scheduled the appointment) and get her groomed immediately - instead, we were told that we had to pay an extra $25 for her to get groomed at 12. What is the point of making an appointment then? They then gave us a 3 hour time window for the grooming, mind you even with an appointment. Keep in mind I have grown up with dogs and never have seen dogs kept in kennels let alone kennels facing the grooming stations in a very small room.

They put her in a kennel while they worked on other dogs and she immediately looked very scared. We were not made aware at the time of booking that she would be put in a kennel with other dogs and in the same room where they groom them. The kennels face the grooming station. Most dogs don’t like getting groomed, let alone having to watch in anticipation.

On the website it says “We understand that each pet has unique needs and we are committed to ensuring you are satisfied with your pets grooming.” Well, we let them know she’s a very timid dog and tends to be loud/reactive when she sees other dogs. And they went ahead and put her straight into the kennel. They were already walking into the room with her while we were saying this and kind of brushed our comments off.

Do not take your dog here if 1) you plan to get them groomed at the same time you schedule an appointment for them to get groomed and 2) if you want your dog to get locked up in a kennel and have to watch other dogs get groomed.

Final note: When we picked her up we noticed her ears were still very wet.

TLDR: the shop is clean and they have a lot of great quality products. The grooming results were also good but the service and actions leading up to the service were unsatisfactory and not what we expected.
